toegepas.blok: Die oomblikke waarop die storie draai
toegepas.voor: Sipho Anna se fiets breek en niks sê nie
toegepas.na: Sipho Anna se fiets stukkend maak en niks sê nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Transitive 'iemand se fiets breek' is an anglicism; 'stukkend maak' is the natural Afrikaans, and the later intransitive 'wanneer die fiets breek' can stay.
toegepas.fout: Transitive 'iemand se fiets breek' is unidiomatic; Afrikaans breaks glass or a bone, but makes a bicycle stukkend.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Stukkend maak' is the natural verb for the action, with the same person, act and moment, and the later intransitive 'wanneer die fiets breek' still fits.

toegepas.blok: Die oomblikke waarop die storie draai
toegepas.voor: Tog word die probleem nie altyd opgelos nie.
toegepas.na: Tog word die probleem in 'n drama nie altyd opgelos nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Right after Anna and Sipho, 'die probleem' reads as their problem; the sentence means dramas in general.
toegepas.fout: Straight after Anna and Sipho's story, the definite 'die probleem' has no clear referent, so it can read as their problem, which was in fact resolved.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Anchoring it to 'in 'n drama' makes the general claim explicit, adds no fact and keeps the qualifier 'nie altyd' intact.

toegepas.voor: trek dalk sy skoene uit voor hy 'n huis ingaan
toegepas.na: trek dalk sy skoene uit voordat hy 'n huis ingaan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Voordat' is the standard conjunction and matches 'voordat jy oordeel' in the next sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'Voor' used as a conjunction is colloquial in written text, and the very next sentence uses the standard 'voordat'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Voordat' is the standard written conjunction, matches its neighbour and changes nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Praat daarna met dieselfde kykpunte oor julle eie en ander groepe se optredes.
toegepas.na: Gebruik daarna dieselfde kykpunte om oor julle eie en ander groepe se optredes te praat.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Praat met kykpunte' reads as talking to the viewpoints; using them to talk is what is meant.
toegepas.fout: 'Praat met dieselfde kykpunte' can read as talking to the viewpoints.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says plainly that the viewpoints are used to talk about the performances, which is what the original means, and it removes the stumble.

laat_vaar.na: om jammer te sê is moeilik
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A verb phrase used as subject takes the 'om ... te' infinitive in standard Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A bare verbal phrase as subject ('jammer sê is moeilik') is correct, natural Afrikaans, like 'swem is lekker', so the om-te form is only a more formal alternative.

laat_vaar.voor: Lag gerus saam met 'n grappige oomblik
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Saam met' is used with people, not moments (calque of 'laugh with'); 'lag vir' is idiomatic and keeps the contrast with 'nie vir 'n kultuur nie'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The preposition carries the point: 'saam met' means laughing along with the moment and 'vir' means laughing at, so the swap erases the with/at contrast the sentence is built on.

vlae.rede: A door is not itself a sound; something like 'n deur wat toeklap' would be clearer, but that adds detail, so the reviewer or writer should decide.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Daarom ... daar' doubles the reference to the radio drama and reads clumsily; 'Daarom' already carries it, and a word is saved.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Daar' ties the sound effects to the radio drama; without it the sentence reads as a general claim, so information is lost and the original reads acceptably.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'maar nie vir 'n kultuur nie' has no subject and verb of its own and joins a command, so under AWS 2017 it takes no comma.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A contrastive comma before 'maar' is normal Afrikaans practice and helps the Grade 5 reader; the never-a-comma rule applies to 'en', so removing it is not an improvement.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Met oefen' uses a bare verb as a noun after a preposition; 'deur oefening' is the correct and natural form, same word count.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The preposition change moves the meaning from what changed while they rehearsed to what changed because of rehearsing, and 'met oefen' is acceptable Afrikaans.
